audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers shipped the generic Ziggs-favoured chart (five rows to Ziggs at 8/10) while every single content why on the same page says the opposite — level 2 and 3 are his, first item and two items are his.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen] over 925 games at 51.68%, and the whys array already agrees with it row for row. Only the side/rating layer was left on the template.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 realigned as matched full/content pairs with ratings 5/3/3/-/5/3/3, and the six full-layer whys rewritten so they stop promising a poke lane you do not have.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike and the item rows as Blackfire Torch spikes, with no mention that his ultimate heals or that his dash scales with your health.
audit.why: Grim Deliverance is 110/95/80s at 600 range and heals him for a portion of the damage dealt; Aureate Rush is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and its damage is flagged percent-health, so stacking raw resistances reads the trade wrong. Your R is 120s at rank 1 and adds cross-map pressure but zero self-peel — which the content layer already said and the full layer contradicted.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten around those numbers; late now names Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names are fabricated: his E is called 'Golden Onslaught' and his R 'Final Retribution'. The whole full layer also calls his ultimate simply 'Ultimate' — no name at all — and the displacement race that decides every trade is never stated.
audit.why: The real names are Aureate Rush (E) and Grim Deliverance (R); The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Dreaded Return (W) are correct where used. Riot's kit: The Darkin Glaive is 10/9/8/7/6s, an auto-attack reset that heals him and can be recast for a knock-up; Dreaded Return is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s at 850 range and pulls you toward him. Both sides carry displacement — your Satchel Charge against his Glaive knock-up and W pull — so whoever lands it first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[0], wants.foe[2], late, winCon, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d rewritten with the real names, the cooldowns, the auto-reset tell and the displacement race.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Aureate Rush at 10s rank 1 — while that dash is up there is no safe step-up, and a whiffed one is the only free window the lane offers.
audit.corrected: winCon and dosFull[2].d now key the step-up explicitly to that 10s.

edits.after: Level 1 is even farming, but you are fragile the moment he steps up, and The Darkin Glaive opens as an auto-reset — the wind-up is your cue, not a cast. edits.before: There is no item count where you out-duel him - at one item he dives you the moment W is down, and at two his E plus R lockdown runs you over regardless.
